name: goldilocks
description: A Superpowers-compatible workflow and structured-artifact orchestration suite with constant quality standards.

interface.longDescription: Provides thirteen familiar workflow entries, a structured-artifact production entry, and a Goldilocks router backed by six shared engines. It dynamically chooses Direct, Lead-to-Fast, Lead-to-Standard, or Lead-to-Standard-to-Fast execution; coordinates replaceable artifact units with localized rework and one integration owner; preserves continuity; and keeps final review and integration with Lead.
defaultPrompt: Use the smallest workflow that preserves full quality.
Plan and execute this with the shallowest useful agent hierarchy.
Keep Lead on direction and integration; delegate complete contracts, including replaceable artifact units.
